one_line_core_task: Draw a complete EER diagram for the ARRMS agricultural scenario. [printed BL=6]
question_text: An Agricultural Research and Resource Management System (ARRMS) monitors crop yield optimization, soil dynamics, and farm infrastructure across multiple agricultural zones: Every STAKEHOLDER in the system has a unique National_ID, Name, Primary_Contact, and one or more Assigned_Agri_Zones. Stakeholders are specialized into FARM_OWNER and AGRONOMIST. A person can be both a Farm Owner and an Agronomist simultaneously. Farm Owners have an Ownership_License_No and Total_Land_Area. Agronomists have a Degree_Specialization and Research_Institute. A CROP is classified into either a FOOD_CROP (has Nutritional_Grade and Storage_Life_Days) or an INDUSTRIAL_CROP (has Processing_Industry_Type and Extraction_Yield_Pct). A crop must belong to exactly one of these two categories and cannot belong to both. Each Crop has a unique Crop_ID, Botanical_Name, and Optimal_pH_Range. Each FARM_PARCEL (identified by Parcel_No within a specific Agri_Zone_ID) is located inside a designated AGRI_ZONE (has unique Agri_Zone_ID and Climatic_Region). To monitor crop conditions, each Farm Parcel is deployed with multiple IOT_SOIL_SENSORS (identified by Sensor_ID relative to the Farm Parcel where it is installed). Sensors measure Moisture_Level and Nitrate_Content. Agronomists conduct FIELD_TRIALS on specific Crops cultivated within specific Farm Parcels. An experiment is a three-way interaction between an AGRONOMIST, a CROP, and a FARM_PARCEL. Because a single trial (AGRI_EXPERIMENT_EVENT) involves controlled resource allocation over time, the system treats the combination of (AGRONOMIST, CROP, FARM_PARCEL). Each AGRI_EXPERIMENT_EVENT is allocated specific IRRIGATION_SCHEDULES (has Water_Volume_Liters and Frequency). Draw a complete EER Diagram for the given scenario.
